task.name: Pack_DJ_gear_after_event
task.when: After the Sound Lead ends the event

resources.resource: Enough people to move each assigned item without dragging it or lifting alone

step.action: Wait for the Sound Lead to confirm that the assigned gear is powered down.
Disconnect only the cable or item assigned to you by the Sound Lead.
Pack each assigned item in the case or cover identified by the Sound Lead.
Move each packed item to its assigned place in 🔧 Equipment_Truck.
Tell the Sound Lead about any missing or damaged item.

passWhen.criterion: Every assigned item is packed in its correct case or cover.
Every packed item is in the truck position assigned by the Sound Lead.
The Sound Lead received any missing-item or damage report.
